metadata.title: ESPR core Digital Product Passport readiness snapshot
metadata.disclaimer: This rule pack checks source-data readiness against selected horizontal ESPR concepts. It is not legal advice, conformity assessment, product-specific delegated-act validation, or a submission to the EU DPP Registry.

checks.title: Product name
checks.description: A stable human-readable product name anchors the source record.
checks.remediation: Set product.name in product.json.
basis: ESPR Article 10(1)(a) and Annex III identification concepts

checks.title: Identifier scheme
checks.description: The product identifier scheme must be explicit.
checks.remediation: Choose gtin or custom and document how uniqueness is governed.

checks.title: Unique product identifier
checks.description: The passport must resolve from a unique persistent product identifier.
checks.remediation: Add the governed identifier value used by the data carrier.

checks.title: GTIN check digit
checks.description: When GTIN is selected, its length and check digit must be valid.
checks.remediation: Correct the GTIN or select custom only when another governed identifier is actually used.

checks.title: Identifier granularity
checks.description: Model, batch, or item scope changes what the source data can truthfully represent.
checks.remediation: Declare whether this record describes a model, batch, or individual item.

checks.title: Product category code
checks.description: A category reference is needed to route later product-specific rules.
checks.remediation: Add the internal or standardized category code and document its vocabulary.

checks.title: Economic operator identifier
checks.description: The responsible manufacturer or operator needs a persistent identifier.
checks.remediation: Add product.manufacturer.operatorId from the governed operator master.

checks.title: Facility identifier
checks.description: The production facility must be distinguishable from the legal operator.
checks.remediation: Add a stable facility identifier and reconcile it with supplier records.

checks.title: Country of production
checks.description: Country provenance supports routing and evidence review.
checks.remediation: Use an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

checks.title: Machine-readable data format
checks.description: The readiness draft is emitted as JSON-LD.
checks.remediation: Set product.dataFormat to json-ld and plan the product-specific vocabulary mapping.

checks.title: Persistent passport URL
checks.description: A secure persistent URL is required before a carrier can be tested.
checks.remediation: Provide an HTTPS URL under a domain with a documented persistence owner.

checks.title: Data carrier binding
checks.description: The carrier type and URI must resolve consistently with the identifier.
checks.remediation: Use QR or Data Matrix and bind its HTTPS URI to the same identifier.

checks.title: Access-right groups
checks.description: Public and restricted data groups need explicit stakeholder roles.
checks.remediation: Declare public and restricted groups plus consumer, authority, and repairer roles.

checks.title: Customer personal-data boundary
checks.description: The source record must not silently collect customer personal data.
checks.remediation: Set the flag to false or establish a separately reviewed consent and privacy design.

checks.title: Bill of materials
checks.description: At least one source component is needed for evidence mapping.
checks.remediation: Export the governed product BOM into bom.csv.

checks.title: Component traceability fields
checks.description: Every component needs minimum identity, material, unit, and origin fields.
checks.remediation: Complete the missing BOM fields with the owning supplier or product team.

checks.title: Supplier ownership links
checks.description: Every BOM line must resolve to a known source owner.
checks.remediation: Add the supplier to suppliers.csv or correct the BOM supplier_id.

checks.title: Component evidence links
checks.description: Every component must reference at least one declared evidence record.
checks.remediation: Add evidence IDs to the BOM and matching rows to evidence.csv.

checks.title: Readable evidence files
checks.description: A spreadsheet reference is not evidence when the underlying file is unavailable.
checks.remediation: Place the declared file inside the dataset and correct its relative path.

checks.title: Declared evidence hashes
checks.description: When a supplier declares a digest, the local bytes must match it.
checks.remediation: Investigate the byte difference, then update only from the authoritative evidence file.

checks.title: Evidence dates
checks.description: Expired, future-dated, and malformed evidence dates require review.
checks.remediation: Request current evidence or correct the issued and validity dates at source.

checks.title: BOM mass reconciliation
checks.description: Mapped component mass should reconcile with product net mass.
checks.remediation: Resolve excluded components, packaging scope, units, or stale mass values.

checks.title: Repair and spare-part links
checks.description: Persistent service information is useful before product-specific rules arrive.
checks.remediation: Publish stable HTTPS repair instructions and spare-part information.
